page.overview:
What is Edenia?

Edenia is one of the six main realms in the Mortal Kombat universe.

The earliest known ruler of Edenia was King Jerrod, the husband of Sindel and the father of Kitana, but he was killed by Shao Kahn & D'Vorah. Edenia also has a military force called the "Edenian Resistance," also known as the Edenian Knights, of which Jade is the general.

Edenia is known for its delicious Edenian Pie, which is a dessert considered a rare delicacy and loved by many inhabitants, including those that are not native to Edenia, such as Shao Kahn's guards. Edenia is also the home of the large and long-forgotten "Edenian Ruins," which are located in Edenia's old Southlands filled with forgotten craters, as well as the fabled Pyramid of Argus and its construction long ago.

Taven and his brother fought alongside their father and the dragons Orin and Caro, repelling an attempted invasion by Shao Kahn in the realm of Edenia.
